name: LABUBU self-transfer doubles the sender's balance
summary: LABUBU's _transfer reads the sender's and recipient's balances first and writes the recipient's afterwards, so a transfer to oneself overwrites the debit with balance + amount. Inside a flash loan of 4.16B LABUBU from the LABUBU/VOVO PancakeSwap V3 pool, the attacker transferred the loan to itself 30 times, repaid it, and swapped the inflated LABUBU into the same pool for 12.6B VOVO, which it sold for 17.4 BNB.
notes: Campaign: LABUBU Transfer logs from deployment to the current block show self-transfers only in the anchor, and only two transfers after it (the deployer's).
Victim is the LABUBU/VOVO V3 pool's VOVO. VOVO has no price and the attacker's sale took most of the VOVO/WBNB pair's WBNB, so it is valued at what the attacker realised, 17.403 BNB (rule 12).
